hook: Sanju Samson made 4 off 10 today. That's 9 single-figure scores in 19 innings since the World Cup final.
lines: Before that: 97, 89 and 89 in his last three World Cup innings. India won all three.
Since the final, he's 25 runs above par per 100 balls. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is 60.
In his first 10 balls, Sanju scores at 121 and falls every 12 balls.
Since the final, his batting has taken 44 percentage points off India's win chances. Vaibhav's has added 40.
